name: Clarity SEO
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
Lightweight SEO plugin: meta tags, schema markup, dynamic sitemap, robots.txt, readability scoring, focus keywords, redirects, image SEO

Clarity SEO is a lightweight WordPress SEO plugin delivering essential tools in under 100KB. Customize per-page meta tags (title, description, keywords, Open Graph), add rich Schema.org markup (20+ types), generate dynamic XML sitemaps with images/video/news support, manage virtual robots.txt, analyze readability, optimize focus keywords, handle advanced redirects, auto-improve image alts, add local business schema, track keywords via GSC, and more.

Key Features:
* Per-Page Meta & OG Tags — Auto-fill from title/excerpt/content + manual override in Gutenberg sidebar.
* Advanced Schema — WebPage, Article, FAQPage, VideoObject, LocalBusiness, Product + custom types.
* Readability Score — Real-time Flesch-Kincaid in editor (aim for 60+).
* Focus Keywords — Up to 5 per post with density tips + internal linking suggestions.
* Dynamic Sitemap — /sitemap.xml with priorities, changefreq, images, video/news tags.
* Redirect Manager — 301 redirects with regex support + 404 logging/monitoring.
* Image SEO — Auto alt/title on upload + bulk find/replace.
* Local SEO — Business address + geo coordinates schema.
* GSC Integration — Fetch top pages and URL index status (requires valid OAuth2 access token).
* Keyword Tracking — Position history + weekly email reports (GSC-based).
* SEO Audit — 30+ point checklist under Tools.
* Breadcrumbs — Shortcode [clarity_seo_breadcrumbs] with schema.
* Setup Wizard — Quick onboarding for globals (logo, social, contact).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clarity-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Run the Setup Wizard at Settings → SEO Wizard.
  4. Configure global options at Settings → SEO Optimizer.
  5. Edit posts/pages — the Clarity SEO metabox appears automatically.
sections.faq:
Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes — metabox on products, schema on product pages, sitemap includes products.

How accurate is the readability score?

Uses Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level formula. Aim for 60–70 for good readability. It’s approximate; always refine manually.

Can I add custom post types?

Yes — use the seo_schema_add_metabox filter to extend supported types.

Does it conflict with Yoast/Rank Math?

Priority 1 output helps, but disable duplicate meta/schema in other plugins.

How do I set up GSC integration?

Add a valid OAuth2 access token (not just API key) in settings. Full setup guide available in Pro version.
